candidate_workaround: Insert the repository root at the front of sys.path before loading named repository test modules in-process.
failure_signature: An in-process unittest loader launched from the scripts directory resolves the wrong tests namespace and returns one import error per named module.
recurrence_guard: Bind named test loading to the exact repository root before constructing the unittest suite.
rollback: Retain the three import errors, give the failed selection zero test credit, and retry only after repository-root binding.
scope_boundary: Authorized bounded test modules only; the complete repository suite remains excluded for non-Eiren phases.
title: Repository-root binding for in-process unittest loading
trigger_preconditions: A validation runner loads repository test modules in-process from a script below the repository root.
